label: light hold gate
info:
Keeps the light on for hold_min minutes after it is switched on, so
an empty-room radar automation cannot turn it off while you sit still.

Inputs
  cmnd/light/POWER  human intent (the CYD panel, Home Assistant, a switch):
                          ON starts the hold, OFF cancels it. Passed straight
                          through to the light, which is already subscribed.
  cmnd/light/auto        automatic requests: point the radar flow's OFF (and any
                          automatic ON) here instead of at the light. OFF during
                          the hold is swallowed, remembered, and honoured once at
                          expiry.
  stat/light/RESULT belt and braces: if the light reports OFF during the
                          hold, turn it back on.

Output
  cmnd/light/POWER  the gate's own commands.

Tuning: set flow.hold_min (default 10) from an inject or a change node.

name: hold window
gate automatic OFF
put it back on
